relationships.subject: SCN11A p.Leu811Phe
relationships.evidence_quote: Sequencing of SCN9A, SCN10A, and SCN11A in the proband revealed a novel heterozygous variant of SCN11A: g.38894937G>A (c.2431C>T, p.Leu811Phe).

relationships.subject: SCN11A p.Leu811Pro
relationships.evidence_quote: On the other hand, the c.2432T>C (p.Leu811Pro) variant is known to cause congenital insensitivity to pain (CIP).

relationships.subject: SCN11A p.Leu811Phe
relationships.evidence_quote: Molecular dynamics simulations showed that p.Leu811Phe increased the structural stability of Nav1.9 and prevented the necessary conformational changes, resulting in changes in the dynamics required for function.

key_findings: Novel SCN11A p.Leu811Phe variant segregates with FEPS in a four-generation Japanese family.
Molecular dynamics: Leu811Phe stabilizes Nav1.9 whereas CIP-related Leu811Pro destabilizes it.
